_description: Grounded multi-turn chat query-rewrite eval (Surface A, docs/specs/grounded-agentic-chat.md §9.1). Each case is a conversation HISTORY + a FOLLOW-UP whose references the control-layer rewrite must resolve; the score is gold-chunk recall@k of hybrid_search on the REWRITTEN query (retrieval-isolated — no rerank/LLM in the inner metric).
_doc_note: Source documents stay LOCAL (tests/eval-data/README.md); only this case set ships. `relevant_chunk_ids` are GOLD chunks from THIS vault — resolve them against your live index before running. The cases below are ILLUSTRATIVE placeholders (the chunk ids are NOT real) showing the format; replace with real gold ids (and add cases) for a meaningful baseline.
_metric: mean_recall = mean over cases of gold_chunk_recall(hybrid_search(rewritten_query)[:k], relevant_chunk_ids, k). A case < 1.0 means the rewrite failed to surface a gold chunk for that follow-up — the A-1.5 follow-up-resolution gap (the trigger for prompt tuning, spec §9.1).
